# nsMsgProgress::SetMsgWindow behavior in mailnews/base/src/nsMsgProgress.cpp

Replaces the stored message-window weak reference, including with a null result when no weak reference can be obtained. Does not require non-null input or report failure to obtain the weak reference.

## State read

- aMsgWindow

## State changed

- m_msgWindow replaced

## Calls and triggers

- MsgComposeCommands.js assigns progress.msgWindow=msgWindow at6570. Firefox do_GetWeakReference obtains weak reference.

## Result and consumers

NS_OK regardless of weak-reference acquisition result.

## Errors

No error output requested from do_GetWeakReference; errors are suppressed.

## Async completion

Synchronous setter.

## Ownership and cleanup

Weak association avoids owning message window; replacing it releases old weak-reference object.

}
